item.title: Reuters joins Snowflake Marketplace to offer AI-ready trusted news content
item.dc:creator: Reuters Communications
item.content:encoded: Reuters today announced its content is now available on Snowflake Marketplace , allowing enterprises to enrich their AI applications and models with factual Reuters news and multimedia content. Reuters upholds the strictest editorial standards and has rigorous processes to ensure content accuracy and integrity. Making this authoritative source data available through controlled marketplaces helps enterprises build more reliable and trustworthy AI systems, while ensuring proper licensing and compensation for Reuters intellectual property.   Through Snowflake Marketplace, enterprises can access and integrate Reuters journalism dating back to 1987 across five languages directly within their AI workflows. This enables customers to build AI applications that can track evolving events, analyze companies and industries over time, surface market and geopolitical signals and deliver accurate, contextualized insights that help people and AI systems make more informed decisions. "AI is rapidly transforming how news and information is consumed and activated. We're proud to partner with Snowflake to enable responsible AI innovation built on Reuters unmatched journalism," said Erika Young, Strategic Business Development Director for Reuters. "This marketplace integration allows us to participate in the AI ecosystem under proper licensing terms that uphold our intellectual property rights." Snowflake Marketplace delivers instant, no-copy access to third-party data, apps, and AI products—cutting integration costs and speeding your path from data to AI-driven insights and workflows. With on-platform purchasing and immediate access to data products, Snowflake Marketplace lowers integration costs and streamlines procurement processes. Learn more about licensing Reuters content for AI use on Snowflake . Media Contact: Heather Carpenter Heather.Carpenter @ tr.com

item.title: Trump: time to teach Canada you can't do this anymore
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday it is "time to teach Canada you can't do this anymore," just days after trade talks between the neighboring countries broke down.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday it is "time to teach Canada you can't do this anymore," just days after trade talks between the neighboring countries broke down. "I had a deal, that was a pretty good deal, you know, quite good," Trump told Glenn Beck in an interview. "They don't have anything that we have to have, okay, we can get by. I mean, there are a couple of things that would make it a little inconvenient, but we can get them elsewhere. And it's time to teach Canada you can't do this anymore," Trump said. Trump imposed new 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian imports on Saturday after talks between the two countries collapsed. Canada hit back on Tuesday with retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. annual imports and rolled out aid for businesses and workers, matching Washington's latest duties dollar-for-dollar.

item.title: Lidl-owner to invest billions on data centre in northern Germany, FAZ says
item.description: German supermarket conglomerate Schwarz Group, which owns the discount retailer Lidl, plans to invest billions of euros to build a data centre in northern Germany, the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung reported on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German supermarket conglomerate Schwarz Group, which owns the discount retailer Lidl, plans to invest billions of euros to build a data centre in northern Germany, the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung reported on Wednesday. Data centre to be built near Rostock city in the state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, FAZ says. Through its Schwarz Digits division, Schwarz is positioning itself as a "digitally sovereign" alternative to U.S. tech giants, FAZ says. Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania goes to the polls in state election in September, with incumbent Social Democrat state premier Manuela Schwesig facing a potential challenge from the far-right Alternative for Germany. Schwarz Group could not immediately be reached for comment.

item.title: Ministro de Hacienda alemán invita al director general de UniCredit a una reunión, según fuentes del Gobierno
item.description: El ministro de Hacienda alemán, Lars Klingbeil, tiene previsto reunirse con el CEO de UniCredit , Andrea Orcel, según informaron fuentes gubernamentales a Reuters, en lo que supone una primera señal de que Berlín está dispuesta a dialogar directamente con el banco italiano sobre su oferta por Commerzbank .
item.dc:creator: Christian Kraemer
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Hacienda alemán, Lars Klingbeil, tiene previsto reunirse con el CEO de UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , Andrea Orcel, según informaron fuentes gubernamentales a Reuters, en lo que supone una primera señal de que Berlín está dispuesta a dialogar directamente con el banco italiano sobre su oferta por Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) . Klingbeil invitó a Orcel a una reunión en el Ministerio de Finanzas de Berlín el 14 de septiembre, según informaron las fuentes el miércoles. El ministro expondrá la posición del Gobierno alemán en las conversaciones con Orcel y hará hincapié en el papel de Commerzbank en la financiación de la economía alemana, así como en su importancia para Fráncfort como centro financiero, según las fuentes. "Esto complementa las conversaciones entre los dos bancos, que siguen siendo los responsables de debatir directamente el camino a seguir", añadió una de las fuentes. Berlín había insistido previamente en que UniCredit y Commerzbank mantuvieran conversaciones directas antes de entablar negociaciones con la entidad italiana. La campaña de Commerzbank contra la adquisición por parte de UniCredit se desvaneció en julio, después de que la entidad italiana acumulara una participación de hasta el 49,65%, suficiente para determinar los acuerdos de los accionistas. El Gobierno alemán, que sigue poseyendo algo más del 12% de la entidad con sede en Fráncfort tras su rescate durante la crisis financiera mundial, se ha resistido durante mucho tiempo a una adquisición, al igual que la dirección de Commerzbank. El presidente del consejo de supervisión de Commerzbank, Jens Weidmann, declaró el domingo que Berlín debería conservar por ahora su participación en Commerzbank, a pesar de que dicha participación se originó en un paquete de rescate en la crisis. El Gobierno alemán había calificado el enfoque de Orcel de hostil y agresivo. Por su parte, el CEO de UniCredit había presionado para que se entablaran conversaciones con el Gobierno alemán y los representantes de los empleados.

item.title: Matt Waldron to debut for Nationals against visiting Rockies
item.description: Newly acquired right-hander Matt Waldron will make his Nationals debut when Washington hosts the Colorado Rockies in the third contest of a four-game series on Wednesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Newly acquired right-hander Matt Waldron will make his Nationals debut when Washington hosts the Colorado Rockies in the third contest of a four-game series on Wednesday night. Colorado took the second game of the set 3-1 on Tuesday night to end a season-worst seven-game losing streak. Washington has lost nine of its past 11 games, and its offensive woes returned one night after the team scored 13 runs in an easy victory. Waldron, claimed off waivers from the Toronto Blue Jays this past weekend, spent most of this season with the San Diego Padres before being designated for assignment in late July and claimed by the Blue Jays. Waldron, 29, had spent parts of four seasons with the Padres. He is 1-2 with a 7.54 ERA in 14 games this season, three of them starts. For his career, he is 9-17 with a 5.29 ERA in 50 games (36 starts). "I feel like my role has been a little different this year," said Waldron, whose arsenal includes a knuckleball. "I've started games, I've been an opener, and then I've been throwing in the eighth or ninth innings. So any opportunity right now sounds good." Right-hander Tanner Gordon (0-4, 5.75 ERA) will start on Wednesday for the Rockies and will make his 19th appearance and seventh start of the season. Last time out he started against the Cleveland Guardians on Friday and took the loss, allowing five runs on nine hits in 5 1/3 innings of a 9-1 defeat. "I thought TG was good, aside from a couple of uncharacteristic walks to (Steven) Kwan at the top of the order," Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer said. "He was efficient through the first couple of innings." Gordon allowed five runs over four innings in his only prior appearance vs. Washington, a loss in 2024. Catcher Hunter Goodman returned from the injured list Tuesday and hit his 35th homer of the season to give the Rockies an early 1-0 lead. "I thought he impacted both sides of the ball today," Schaeffer said. "Obviously the homer. It's good to have him back in the middle of our lineup." After Mason Adams pitched four-plus innings in his major league debut, the Colorado bullpen locked down the win with five scoreless innings. Daylen Lile homered in his second straight game and added a single for Washington. He has hit safely in four of his last five games, batting .429 (9-for-21) with two doubles, two homers, five runs and seven RBIs. Washington finished with five hits and four walks in the loss. The Nationals are 1-55 when trailing after seven innings. "I think at the end of the day, our mindset is understanding where we're at in the game, and understanding how many we might be trailing by," manager Blake Butera said. "I understand everyone wants to be the hero. But at the end of the day, just getting on base and moving it to the next guy is huge there." Waldron's activation was coupled with veteran right-hander Trevor Williams, 34, being designated for assignment. Signed as a free agent in December 2022, Williams spent parts of four seasons with the Nationals and went 15-21 with a 4.81 ERA. --Field Level Media

item.title: Meta fecha acordo de US$16,68 bilhões sobre danos causados por redes sociais a crianças
item.description: A Meta concordou em pagar um valor máximo de US$16,68 bilhões para resolver ações movidas por Estados dos EUA nas quais se alegava que a empresa projetou Instagram e Facebook para criar dependência em crianças, enganou consumidores quanto à segurança dessas plataformas e coletou indevidamente dados pessoais de crianças que as utilizavam, conforme mostram documentos judiciais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Meta (META.O) concordou em pagar um valor máximo de US$16,68 bilhões para resolver ações movidas por Estados dos EUA nas quais se alegava que a empresa projetou Instagram e Facebook para criar dependência em crianças, enganou consumidores quanto à segurança dessas plataformas e coletou indevidamente dados pessoais de crianças que as utilizavam, conforme mostram documentos judiciais. O acordo foi fechado durante um julgamento em um tribunal federal da Califórnia sobre ações movidas por 29 Estados, evitando um dos testes mais importantes até o momento sobre as alegações de que empresas de rede social causaram danos a jovens usuários. A Meta também concordou em implementar mudanças para usuários adolescentes do Facebook e do Instagram em todo o país, incluindo limites diários de uso e bloqueios noturnos, segundo documentos judiciais. A empresa, sediada em Menlo Park, na Califórnia, negou qualquer irregularidade ao aceitar o acordo. As ações da Meta subiram 4,4% nas negociações de pré-mercado. As reivindicações fazem parte de uma onda mais ampla de processos movidos por Estados, governos locais, distritos escolares e indivíduos, alegando que a Meta e outras empresas de mídia social alimentaram uma crise nacional de saúde mental entre os jovens. O julgamento federal abrangeu alegações de procuradores da Califórnia, Colorado, Kentucky e Nova Jersey de que a Meta violou as leis estaduais de proteção ao consumidor. O julgamento também envolveu alegações de 29 Estados de que a Meta violou a Lei Federal de Proteção à Privacidade Online das Crianças ao coletar dados pessoais de usuários que sabia serem crianças sem notificação ou consentimento dos pais, e ao usar esses dados para treinar modelos de aprendizado de máquina e IA generativa. A Meta negou as acusações, afirmando que tem se empenhado para proteger as crianças em suas plataformas. A empresa argumentou que não poderia ter induzido os consumidores em erro quanto ao caráter viciante de seus serviços, pois o “vício em redes sociais” não é uma condição psiquiátrica reconhecida. Em um documento apresentado antes do julgamento, a Meta disse que Califórnia, Colorado, Kentucky e Nova Jersey estavam buscando multas de até US$1,4 trilhão. Os Estados não revelaram um valor específico em dólares, mas afirmaram, em uma audiência antes do início do julgamento, que o valor estaria mais próximo de US$200 bilhões. Os Estados também buscavam indenizações monetárias adicionais, além de uma ordem determinando que a Meta fizesse mudanças significativas em suas plataformas e impedisse que crianças criassem contas. Meta, Snapchat e sua controladora Snap Inc (SNAP.N) , YouTube e sua controladora Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , e o TikTok e sua controladora ByteDance ainda enfrentam milhares de ações judiciais em tribunais federais e estaduais por alegações de que projetaram conscientemente suas plataformas para ter recursos que causam dependência em crianças e adolescentes, alimentando uma crise de saúde mental.

item.title: Fed seen a bit more likely to hike after inflation data
item.description: The case for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike gained a little steam on Wednesday after a government report showed inflation in July was a touch stronger than economists had expected.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The case for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike gained a little steam on Wednesday after a government report showed inflation in July was a touch stronger than economists had expected. The 12-month gain in the personal consumption expenditures price index, which the Fed targets at 2%, edged up to 3.7% last month from 3.6% in the month prior, the Commerce Department said. Core PCE inflation, which strips out volatile food and energy and is seen as an indicator of underlying inflation pressures, was 3.3% from a year earlier, no better than it had been in June. The Fed has held its policy rate steady in the 3.50%-3.75% range since December, and though Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh has vowed to end above-target inflation he has not given any indication about whether he believes it will recede without interest-rate hikes. Wednesday's data do not show it is, in conflict with earlier reports that did show a slowdown in consumer price inflation over the last couple of months. “The United States still has an inflation problem," said Heather Long, chief economist at Navy Federal Credit Union. "The latest data give (Warsh) time to wait and see, but he has to be more clear about what he’s watching closely and what it would take for him to hike rates." Fed funds futures prices now reflect about a 44% probability of a September Fed rate hike, versus about 36% immediately before, and show traders are fully convinced that the Fed will have raised the policy rate by the end of the year.

item.title: Astros intent to 'keep pushing' in rematch vs. Yankees
item.description: Recent events led to a new urgency for the Houston Astros and a rare bullpen hiccup by the New York Yankees.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Recent events led to a new urgency for the Houston Astros and a rare bullpen hiccup by the New York Yankees. The Astros seek another productive showing at the plate Wednesday night when the teams continue their three-game series in New York. Houston is 6-9 in its past 15 games and opened its six-game visit to New York against the Yankees and Mets by earning a 9-7 victory on Tuesday. The Astros moved back to .500 and back to a half-game over the Texas Rangers in the American League West. Houston will play its second game after parting ways with general manager Dana Brown after 3 1/2 seasons. After ousting Brown, owner Jim Crane said Joe Espada will be the manager for the rest of the season. "This is the way we need to come here and play," Espada said following his team's 14-hit performance. "Any other way wasn't going to be acceptable. We needed to come here today and play like a team that needs to go win a division." Yordan Alvarez will head into Wednesday with a major league-best .323 batting average after highlighting a three-hit game with a tiebreaking RBI triple off Brent Headrick in the eighth inning. Alvarez is batting .333 (14-for-42) in his past 13 games and .581 (18-for-31) in his past seven games versus the Yankees, against whom he is hitting .328 in his career. Yainer Diaz is hitting .344 in his past 22 games after belting a pair of solo homers among his three hits. "You got to keep pushing," said Pena, who scored on Alvarez's triple and also homered. "This is the final stretch. Every game means so much, especially to our ball club. We got to treat every game like it's a playoff game." The Yankees own a 3.06 bullpen earned run average after the group allowed six runs in the series opener and prevented them from moving within 2 1/2 games of the Rays in the AL East. Headrick was scored upon for the 12th time in 68 games, and his appearances are second to Toronto's Mason Fluharty among major league leaders. "We are now," Yankees manager Aaron Boone said about keeping an eye on Headrick's workload. "Tonight was a night where I was reluctant to even use him. So we'll pick our spots to get him a couple of days. So we're paying attention to that, of course." New York is 6-2 in its past eight games and 10-6 in the past 16. The Yankees are coming off scoring at least nine runs for the third time since the All-Star break and getting 10 hits. The Yankees did not announce their starter but right-hander Elmer Rodriguez (0-2, 4.76) is expected to get called up from Triple-A Scranton Wilkes/Barre. Rodriguez has pitched 17 innings for the Yankees and took the loss in his last appearance on June 21 against the Reds when he allowed three runs on four hits in four innings. Rodriguez is 8-3 with a 2.59 ERA in 19 starts at Triple-A this season. He last pitched on Aug. 18 when he yielded one run on six hits in five innings against Charlotte. Peter Lambert (8-7, 3.68), who is 0-2 with a 4.95 ERA in his past seven starts, will get the start for Houston and face the Yankees for the first time. Lambert tied a career high by allowing nine runs on eight hits in 3 2/3 innings during Houston's 18-3 home loss to the Los Angeles Angels on Thursday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Feyenoord ban their own travelling fans from next two away matches
item.description: Feyenoord will not allow travelling supporters to attend their next two away matches after fans let off fireworks that injured seven people and held up their Dutch league game at Cambuur Leeuwarden on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Feyenoord will not allow travelling supporters to attend their next two away matches after fans let off fireworks that injured seven people and held up their Dutch league game at Cambuur Leeuwarden on Sunday. Feyenoord are barring their fans from the away sections at NEC Nijmegen and PEC Zwolle next month. "The club management has decided to do this following the much-discussed and completely unacceptable fireworks incident in Leeuwarden last Sunday," the club said on Wednesday. Feyenoord face a heavy fine for the incident in Leeuwarden as home supporters suffered burns, hearing damage and eye injuries, with the match halted for around 20 minutes in the first half, after away fans lit a large number of red flares and threw fireworks.

item.title: Japan's Okamoto says recalled condoms were not intended for French market
item.description: Japanese consumer goods maker Okamoto Industries said on Wednesday its condoms that were recalled in France were not intended to be sold on the French market and thus lacked proper labelling.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japanese consumer goods maker Okamoto Industries (5122.T) said on Wednesday its condoms [USN:L1N44I0L4 TEXT:"that were recalled in France"] were not intended to be sold on the French market and thus lacked proper labelling. The two brands subject to the recall were designed for the Japanese market only and nevertheless entered the French market through unofficial channels, a company spokesperson said in an emailed statement. As these products did not bear the CE mark required in Europe, the French regulatory authorities determined that they did not comply with the EU regulation. All Okamoto condom products sold in France through authorized channels have been formally approved for sale in the local market and comply with the applicable requirements concerning labelling, the company spokesperson added. French anti-fraud and health agencies had issued a warning on Friday against tens of thousands of potentially unsafe condoms and recalled several brands (including two made by Okamoto), some of which lacked the EU conformity seal or labelling in French, sold online or in shops and pharmacies.

item.title: No Tesla recall in Europe at present, Dutch regulator says
item.description: The Dutch vehicle regulator RDW said on Wednesday there is currently no recall of Tesla cars in Europe over concerns that doors may be difficult to open in an emergency.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Dutch vehicle regulator RDW said on Wednesday there is currently no recall of Tesla (TSLA.O) cars in Europe over concerns that doors may be difficult to open in an emergency. China last week undertook its [USN:L1N44I0AY TEXT:"largest ever"] car recall, covering 4.3 million vehicles and 2.98 million Teslas, over worries that emergency door-release mechanisms can be difficult to locate or operate after a crash. The RDW is the key regulator overseeing the safety of Tesla cars in Europe. The agency said in written answers to Reuters questions that it is monitoring the issue but declined to comment on whether it is considering or investigating a recall - only that there is none at present. "The RDW believes that vehicles must be capable of being opened under all circumstances — including when electrical systems fail — in an intuitive way, without the use of tools, from both inside and outside," it said. It noted that door handles that are flush or recessed, a feature of Teslas, were not in themselves a problem. The agency said that improving the ability to open doors in emergencies is under discussion both in U.N. vehicle-regulation talks in Geneva and at Euro NCAP, the independent European New Car Assessment Programme that awards vehicle safety ratings. "This is because, in recent years, there have been incidents in which occupants or emergency responders had difficulty opening vehicles following an accident or fire," the agency said.

item.title: US voices 'significant concerns' over Chinese dissident artist Gao Zhen's prison sentence
item.description: The U.S. State Department said it has "significant concerns" over the case of Chinese artist Gao Zhen, who was sentenced to three years in prison by a Chinese court on Tuesday over dissident artworks, and said its diplomats were refused entry to the sentencing hearing.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. State Department said it has "significant concerns" over the case of Chinese artist Gao Zhen, who was [USN:L6N44M0K2 TEXT:"sentenced to three years in prison"] by a Chinese court on Tuesday over dissident artworks, and said its diplomats were refused entry to the sentencing hearing. "We have significant concerns regarding the case, against Gao Zhen, which we note was in connection with alleged actions taken years prior to the enactment of the law under which he was convicted," a State Department spokesperson told Reuters in an emailed statement. "The United States continues to support the right to freedom of expression, including as exercised through art," the spokesperson said. New York-based Gao, 70, was known for making satirical sculptures of former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. He was detained in August 2024 during a visit to China from the U.S. and was tried earlier this year in a one-day closed-door trial. Gao was handed the maximum three-year sentence for "defaming national heroes and martyrs" under China's "Law on the Protection of Heroes and Martyrs" by a Chinese court on Tuesday, his wife and a rights group told Reuters. Gao's wife, Zhao Yaliang, and his son, a U.S. citizen, had been blocked from leaving China since his detention two years ago, Zhao had previously told Reuters. "Diplomats from the U.S. Embassy in Beijing and several other diplomatic missions attempted to observe the verdict and sentencing hearing in Sanhe, Hebei Province, on August 25," the U.S. State Department spokesperson said. "Courthouse officials denied them entry to the hearing room," they added.

item.title: Meta llega a acuerdo con varios estados de EEUU por los perjuicios causados por las redes sociales
item.description: Meta Platforms llegó a un acuerdo para resolver las demandas presentadas por varios estados de Estados Unidos, que acusaban a la empresa de haber diseñado Instagram y Facebook para crear adicción en los menores, de engañar a los consumidores sobre su seguridad y de haber recopilado indebidamente datos personales de los menores que usaban sus plataformas, según se desprende de documentos judiciales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms llegó a un acuerdo para resolver las demandas presentadas por varios estados de Estados Unidos, que acusaban a la empresa de haber diseñado Instagram y Facebook para crear adicción en los menores, de engañar a los consumidores sobre su seguridad y de haber recopilado indebidamente datos personales de los menores que usaban sus plataformas, según se desprende de documentos judiciales. El acuerdo se alcanzó durante un juicio en una corte federal de California por las demandas presentadas por 29 estados, lo que evitó una de las pruebas más sonadas hasta la fecha sobre las acusaciones de que las empresas de redes sociales perjudicaron a los jóvenes. Apenas unos días antes de que comenzara la selección del jurado el 12 de agosto, un tribunal federal de apelación se negó a suspender el juicio. Estas demandas forman parte de una oleada más amplia de litigios interpuestos por estados, gobiernos locales, distritos escolares y particulares que alegan que Meta (META.O) y otras empresas de redes sociales han agravado una crisis nacional de salud mental entre los jóvenes. El juicio federal abarcó las demandas de los fiscales generales de California, Colorado, Kentucky y Nueva Jersey, que alegaban que Meta había infringido sus leyes estatales de protección de los consumidores. El juicio también abarcó las denuncias de que Meta infringió la Ley federal de Protección de la Privacidad Infantil en Internet (COPPA) al recopilar datos personales de menores sin notificación ni consentimiento de los padres, y al usar los datos para entrenar modelos de aprendizaje automático e inteligencia artificial generativa. Meta ha negado las acusaciones, alegando que ha trabajado duro para proteger a los menores en sus plataformas. La empresa argumentó que no podía haber inducido a error a los consumidores sobre si sus servicios eran adictivos, ya que la "adicción a las redes sociales" no es un trastorno psiquiátrico reconocido. En un escrito presentado antes del juicio, Meta señaló que California, Colorado, Kentucky y Nueva Jersey reclamaban hasta 1,4 billones de dólares en sanciones. Los estados no habían revelado una cantidad concreta en dólares, pero afirmaron en una vista que la cifra se acercaría a los 200.000 millones de dólares. Los estados también reclamaban una indemnización por daños y perjuicios adicional, además de una orden que obligara a Meta a introducir cambios importantes en sus plataformas y a impedir que los menores crearan cuentas.

item.title: Video of asylum seeker complaining about UK conditions is AI-generated
item.description: An AI-generated video of a man complaining about his treatment by UK authorities while also demanding more money, a home and freedom has been reshared online as if showing a genuine reaction by a person seeking asylum in Britain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: An AI-generated video of a man complaining about his treatment by UK authorities while also demanding more money, a home and freedom has been reshared online as if showing a genuine reaction by a person seeking asylum in Britain. Here are the key details: Posts shared the video in mid-August, with one asking: "Should the UK do more?" An analysis by Google's SynthID found that the video and its audio were edited or created with the company's AI models. SynthID works by detecting a hidden watermark contained in AI-generated or AI-modified images created by Google models. A BBC report last year featured an asylum seeker in Hull that resembles the man in the social media video. However, the AI-generated footage "does not align with what he told the BBC during his interview", a corporation spokesperson said in an email. Verdict: Synthetic media. Google's SynthID concluded the footage was created using its generative AI models. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

item.title: Ibovespa abre sem viés claro com dados de inflação no foco
item.description: O Ibovespa buscava a sexta alta seguida nesta quarta-feira, apoiado pelo IPCA-15 abaixo das expectativas, mas o ímpeto era atenuado por números mostrando que a inflação nos Estados Unidos permanece acima da meta do Federal Reserve.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa buscava a sexta alta seguida nesta quarta-feira, apoiado pelo IPCA-15 abaixo das expectativas, mas o ímpeto era atenuado por números mostrando que a inflação nos Estados Unidos permanece acima da meta do Federal Reserve. Às 10h08, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) , referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, subia 0,14%, a 174.820,78 pontos. O contrato futuro do índice com prazo mais curto , em 14 de outubro, registrava variação positiva de 0,02%.

item.title: Pirates, with resurgent bullpen, strive for sweep of Padres
item.description: It's an article of faith that the San Diego Padres normally will prevail in tight games because they have one of the top bullpens in the majors.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: It's an article of faith that the San Diego Padres normally will prevail in tight games because they have one of the top bullpens in the majors. Conversely, the Pittsburgh Pirates are four games under .500 and a long shot to make the National League playoffs because their bullpen has failed them more often than not. But if you're looking for a reason why Pittsburgh could polish off a three-game sweep of host San Diego on Wednesday afternoon, the bullpen is as good a place to start as any. The Pirates went as all-in as they ever do at the trade deadline this month, adding veterans Kirby Yates and Camilo Doval to reliable holdovers such as Mason Montgomery and Gregory Soto. And in this series, the Pittsburgh bullpen has outdone the Padres'. After allowing just one run in the last six innings of Monday night's 3-2, 12-inning victory, Pirates relievers backed Paul Skenes' six shutout innings Tuesday evening with three hitless frames. That netted Soto the win when Oneil Cruz launched a two-out solo shot off Padres star Mason Miller in the top of the ninth for the night's only run. "I like how we attacked the strike zone after Paul left," Pittsburgh manager Don Kelly said. "They have a really good bullpen over there, but the fight our guys have showed to bounce back against a really good team ... our bullpen has been pitching really well." Right-hander Bubba Chandler (6-8, 4.38 ERA) will start for the Pirates in the series finale. He's coming off a no-decision Friday in his team's 5-4, 10-inning loss at the Los Angeles Dodgers. Chandler permitted four runs and four hits over four innings, walking two and fanning six in an 88-pitch outing. In his only career outing against San Diego, Chandler absorbed a 5-0 loss on April 6, yielding three runs and five hits in 4 1/3 innings while walking four and whiffing four. On Wednesday he'll oppose Padres right-hander Randy Vasquez (9-6, 4.19 ERA), who last worked Friday in a 6-2 win over Minnesota. Vasquez allowed just two hits and two runs in seven innings, walking none and striking out three. He's 0-0 with a 4.70 ERA in four career outings against Pittsburgh. The Padres entered this series on their best roll of the year, winning 21 of 28 games and taking a two-game lead over Arizona for the National League's last wild-card spot. But that lead is down to a game after the Diamondbacks rallied to beat the Chicago Cubs 5-4 on Tuesday night. For San Diego, a lack of offense -- the team's primary bane over the season's first half -- has reappeared in this series. The Padres have just two runs over 21 innings and consistently have failed to produce a timely hit. "We've faced a lot of tough pitching the last couple of days, and we haven't been able to come through," manager Craig Stammen said. "We have to take advantage of opportunities in games like this. Hopefully, we can do it tomorrow." San Diego went 0-for-7 with runners in scoring position Tuesday and has just one hit in 20 at-bats in that situation during the series. --Field Level Media

item.title: Brazil's inflation cools as prices post first monthly decline in a year
item.description: Brazil's annual inflation slowed more than expected in the 12 months through mid-August as consumer prices posted their first monthly decline in a year, reinforcing signs that price pressures are easing in Latin America's largest economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's annual inflation slowed more than expected in the 12 months through mid-August as consumer prices posted their first monthly decline in a year, reinforcing signs that price pressures are easing in Latin America's largest economy. The IPCA-15 consumer price index rose 4.24% in the 12 months through mid-August, statistics agency IBGE said on Wednesday, down from 4.52% in the previous month and below all estimates in a Reuters poll of economists, whose median forecast was 4.34%. On a monthly basis, prices fell 0.40%, the first negative reading since August 2025. The figure also came in below all forecasts in the Reuters poll, which had pointed to a median decline of 0.30%. Annual inflation remains within the central bank's target range of 3%, plus or minus 1.5 percentage points. The central bank [USN:L1N4421OI TEXT:"cut its benchmark interest rate"] by 25 basis points to 14% this month, marking the fourth consecutive rate cut, and left the door open for further easing as inflation moderates and economic activity cools. The central bank's next policy meeting is set for September 15-16. The monthly IPCA-15 drop was driven mainly by lower housing, transportation, and food prices, according to IBGE. Housing costs fell 1.41%, led by lower electricity bills as consumers benefited from a one-off discount tied to the results of the Itaipu hydroelectric dam. Transportation prices dropped 1%, reflecting cheaper air fares and fuel, while closely-watched food and beverage costs fell 0.57%.

item.title: Costa Rica avanza en construcción de cárcel de máxima seguridad al estilo Bukele
item.description: La presidenta de Costa Rica, Laura Fernández, ha colocado la seguridad como una de las prioridades de su gobierno, que avanza en la construcción del Centro de Alta Contención de la Criminalidad Organizada (CACCO), una prisión de máxima seguridad inspirada parcialmente en las políticas penitenciarias impulsadas por el presidente salvadoreño Nayib Bukele.
item.dc:creator: Héctor Guzmán
item.content:encoded: La presidenta de Costa Rica, Laura Fernández, ha colocado la seguridad como una de las prioridades de su gobierno, que avanza en la construcción del Centro de Alta Contención de la Criminalidad Organizada (CACCO), una prisión de máxima seguridad inspirada parcialmente en las políticas penitenciarias impulsadas por el presidente salvadoreño Nayib Bukele. Las obras del complejo penitenciario en la provincia de Alajuela, a unos 20 kilómetros al noroeste de San José, muestran celdas, pasillos, áreas sanitarias y sistemas de seguridad aún en construcción, según imágenes difundidas por el Ministerio de Justicia en julio. El proyecto busca alojar a reclusos considerados de alta peligrosidad y cortar presuntas operaciones criminales dirigidas desde las cárceles. Fernández, quien defendió la iniciativa desde la campaña electoral, afirmó [USN:L6N3YY0WC TEXT:"tras ganar las elecciones"] que Costa Rica no debía seguir brindando "techo, comida y protección" a delincuentes que continúan operando bandas desde prisión. La mandataria añadió entonces que había conversado con Bukele, quien reiteró su disposición a colaborar con Costa Rica en materia de seguridad y en el desarrollo del proyecto penitenciario. Durante el inicio de las obras en enero, al que asistió Bukele, el mandatario salvadoreño sostuvo que Costa Rica tenía la oportunidad de enfrentar el problema antes de que alcanzara niveles como los observados en El Salvador años atrás. Fernández reiteró el 19 de agosto, al cumplir 100 días de gobierno, que la [USN:L6N41L112 TEXT:"seguridad nacional"] continúa siendo la principal preocupación de los costarricenses y que su administración ha dado máxima prioridad al tema. La cárcel, cuya construcción está al 89%, tendrá capacidad para 5.000 internos, el 25% de la población carcelaria de Costa Rica. Sin embargo, la estrategia ha generado críticas de especialistas en derechos humanos. El analista Marco Feoli afirmó que la política está inspirada en la "espectacularidad" del modelo salvadoreño y argumentó que Costa Rica enfrenta una realidad distinta, sin la fuerte presencia de las peligrosas Maras. También cuestionó la exposición pública de algunos detenidos durante operativos recientes, al considerar que esas prácticas pueden resultar humillantes y carecer de un propósito legítimo de seguridad. Entre la ciudadanía, las opiniones están divididas. Algunos residentes consultados por Reuters respaldaron las medidas más estrictas contra el crimen, argumentando que la delincuencia ha afectado la tranquilidad del país, mientras que otros expresaron dudas sobre la eficacia de una política centrada en endurecer el sistema penitenciario para reducir la criminalidad.

item.title: Italy asks EU for €8 billion in SAFE defence funds
item.description: The Italian government has requested €8 billion ($9.3 billion) from the European Union's SAFE defence funding programme, a source close to the matter said on Wednesday, confirming earlier media reports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Italian government has requested €8 billion ($9.3 billion) from the European Union's SAFE defence funding programme, a source close to the matter said on Wednesday, confirming earlier media reports. The Security Action for Europe (SAFE) instrument is a joint borrowing scheme backed by the EU budget aimed at boosting the bloc's defence capabilities and helping member states meet new, more ambitious NATO spending targets. Italy was eligible for up to €14.9 billion under the facility, which is worth up to €150 billion in total. The source confirmed that Rome had sent a letter to the European Commission formally requesting access to the fund. The decision to tap the SAFE scheme follows [USN:L8N43U15C TEXT:"months of divisions"] within Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's ruling coalition, with Matteo Salvini's League party repeatedly voicing reservations about using the facility. Hiking defence spending is generally unpopular in Italy, opinion polls show, and the government has faced pressure from opposition parties to use its limited fiscal room to cushion the impact of rising energy costs caused by the U.S.-Iran conflict. Defence Minister Guido Crosetto, a senior member of Meloni's Brothers of Italy party, has strongly backed tapping the scheme, which aims at allowing Rome to finance planned spending at a lower interest rate than it would face on the market.

item.title: Sonny Gray, Red Sox vie to keep rolling in finale vs. Marlins
item.description: Right-hander Sonny Gray is close to becoming the first Boston Red Sox pitcher since Rick Porcello in 2016 to win 20 games in a season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Right-hander Sonny Gray is close to becoming the first Boston Red Sox pitcher since Rick Porcello in 2016 to win 20 games in a season. Gray (16-3, 2.79 ERA), who is set to start against the host Miami Marlins in the series finale on Wednesday, is not afraid to talk about his quest to reach the 20-win milestone. "If you want to get black and white about it, yeah, I think 20 wins is doable," Gray told MassLive.com. "It's a great short-term goal for me to have in late August and into September. It would be nice to chase, but it's not going to be given to me. I have to commit to focusing on a daily basis." Gray, who is 3-1 with a 2.81 ERA in seven career appearances against the Marlins, is backed by a strong support system. Closer Aroldis Chapman still throws gas at age 38, and he has 397 career saves, including 30 this season. It's his 10th season with at least 30 saves. "The durability part is special," Boston interim manager Chad Tracy said of Chapman on Tuesday. "A guy his age still cranking it up to 100 mph and still available so much is impressive." Chapman, who was rested on Tuesday, should be ready to go on Wednesday as the Red Sox will try for a three-game sweep of the Marlins. A win would be Boston's sixth consecutive victory. Prior to Tuesday's game, Tracy also praised his catcher, Adley Rutschman, who was acquired from the Orioles on Aug. 3. "He's a great teammate," Tracy said of Rutschman, who was the first overall pick in the 2019 MLB Draft. "He's really great at taking an intense at-bat, and, when the inning is over, he puts on his catching gear and focuses on his pitcher and what he needs to do defensively." As for the Marlins, they will start the polar opposite of Gray as right-hander Ryan Gusto. He has yet to win a game for Miami, going a combined 0-6 with a 5.52 ERA since being acquired last year. This year, Gusto is 0-3 with a 4.37 ERA. He has never faced Boston. If Gusto doesn't give Miami length on Wednesday, it will be tough for the Marlins, who used seven relievers in a 7-3 loss in 11 innings on Tuesday. "We will have to see where some of these guys are," Marlins manager Clayton McCullough said of his relievers. "This whole homestand (has been taxing)." A highlight for Miami on Tuesday was Heriberto Hernandez's homer, his team-best and career-high 20th blast of the season. "'Bert' is a presence in the box," McCullough said. "He can hit fastballs. He can hit mistakes that spin in the zone. From the right side, his ability to provide power for us is really important." Another standout for Miami on Tuesday was third-string catcher Brian Navarreto, who won a 10-pitch battle to hit a sacrifice fly after fouling off six pitches. He also threw out speedy Eli White trying to steal second in the ninth inning. In addition, Navarreto had a sacrifice bunt. "He's a gamer," McCullough said. "He made their pitchers work. He's had some opportunities, and he has come through." --Field Level Media

item.title: Histórico matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo podría abrir camino para más parejas en Bolivia
item.description: El matrimonio de una pareja del mismo sexo en Bolivia este mes podría animar a otras parejas a buscar el mismo reconocimiento, según afirman activistas, lo que podría abrir un nuevo capítulo en la lucha de años por los derechos LGBT en la nación andina conservadora.
item.dc:creator: Sergio Limachi, Andrea Rodriguez
item.content:encoded: El matrimonio de una pareja del mismo sexo en Bolivia este mes podría animar a otras parejas a buscar el mismo reconocimiento, según afirman activistas, lo que podría abrir un nuevo capítulo en la lucha de años por los derechos LGBT en la nación andina conservadora. Fabiana Justiniano y Scarlett Rocha solicitaron casarse en octubre de 2022. Tras casi cuatro años de trámites legales y dos recursos de amparo constitucional, en marzo de 2026 obtuvieron una sentencia que allanó el camino para su boda: el primer matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo reconocido legalmente en Bolivia. “Teníamos muchas dudas, mucha incertidumbre… porque el proceso fue tan largo y hubo tantas barreras, tantas limitaciones, y hasta el día del matrimonio teníamos miedo”, afirmó Rocha. Para Justiniano, la unión supuso un tipo diferente de alivio. “Para mí, el matrimonio significa paz”, afirmó, recordando su primera noche en casa como pareja casada, cuando se dio cuenta de que todo lo que habían construido ahora les pertenecía “solo y únicamente a nosotras”. No obstante, la sentencia del tribunal boliviano solo se aplica a su caso concreto. El matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo aún no está disponible en todo el país según la normativa administrativa de Bolivia y su futura disponibilidad dependerá de futuras sentencias del Tribunal Constitucional. Mateo Rodrigo, abogado de Equal Bolivia que representó a la pareja, señaló que la sentencia ya ha despertado el interés de otras personas. “Desde el matrimonio de Fabiana y Scarlet ya hemos recibido bastantes solicitudes, son más o menos cinco, diez parejas que se nos han acercado”, afirmó, aunque muchas siguen mostrándose reticentes ante la lucha de casi cuatro años que tuvo que soportar la pareja. Las uniones civiles entre personas del mismo sexo también adquirieron carácter legal tras un caso histórico en 2020, cuando David Aruquipa y Guido Montaño ganaron una batalla judicial que duró dos años. Hubo que esperar hasta 2023 para que nuevas sentencias judiciales hicieran posible el registro generalizado de las uniones civiles entre personas del mismo sexo. Desde entonces, Bolivia ha reconocido 148 uniones civiles entre personas del mismo sexo, según Paola Tapia, responsable de la unidad de poblaciones vulnerables de la Defensoría del Pueblo de Bolivia. Añadió que estas uniones siguen ofreciendo menos garantías prácticas que el matrimonio. “Con el matrimonio civil se abren muchas más puertas. Con la unión civil se abrieron algunas”, afirmó Aruquipa. “Es una situación mucho mejor para las personas que puedan elegir entre un matrimonio o una unión civil”. En 2022, Cuba se convirtió en el último país de América Latina en legalizar el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo y la adopción por parte de parejas del mismo sexo, pero desde entonces poco ha cambiado en la región. El matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo sigue siendo ilegal o no está reconocido en gran parte de Centroamérica, Paraguay, Perú, Venezuela, Guyana, Surinam y algunas zonas del Caribe.

item.title: Usa, inflazione ancora persistente a luglio, Pil trim2 invariato a 1,5%
item.description: L’inflazione annuale negli Stati Uniti è rimasta inaspettatamente stabile a luglio, ben al di sopra dell’obiettivo del 2% fissato dalla Federal Reserve per il 65° mese consecutivo, e la pausa nel calo registrato dopo il recente picco innescato dalla guerra con l’Iran rischia di alimentare il già teso dibattito sull’opportunità di alzare o mantenere invariati i tassi di interesse.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L’inflazione annuale negli Stati Uniti è rimasta inaspettatamente stabile a luglio, ben al di sopra dell’obiettivo del 2% fissato dalla Federal Reserve per il 65° mese consecutivo, e la pausa nel calo registrato dopo il recente picco innescato dalla guerra con l’Iran rischia di alimentare il già teso dibattito sull’opportunità di alzare o mantenere invariati i tassi di interesse. L’indice dei prezzi delle spese per i consumi personali (Pce) è aumentato del 3,7% nei 12 mesi fino a luglio, rimanendo invariato rispetto a giugno, secondo quanto comunicato dall’Ufficio di analisi economica del Dipartimento del Commercio. Gli economisti intervistati da Reuters avevano previsto una lettura – che la Fed utilizza per fissare il proprio obiettivo – pari al 3,6%. L'indice Pce ha accelerato a maggio ai massimi degli ultimi tre anni, attestandosi al 4,1%, dopo che il presidente Donald Trump ha lanciato attacchi aerei insieme a Israele contro l’Iran a febbraio. A distanza di sei mesi, il conflitto non sembra essere vicino a una risoluzione definitiva, sebbene gli scontri a fuoco si siano ridotti e i prezzi del greggio - come la più ampia ondata di inflazione innescatasi - si siano allontanati dai massimi raggiunti durante la primavera. Il calo dell’inflazione negli ultimi due mesi ha contribuito a rafforzare le argomentazioni della maggioranza dei membri del Comitato federale per il mercato aperto (Fomc) che a luglio ha votato per lasciare i tassi invariati nella fascia compresa tra il 3,50% e il 3,75%, dove si trovano da dicembre. Tuttavia, il ritmo lento del miglioramento difficilmente placherà una sempre più numerosa minoranza di funzionari secondo cui è necessaria politica più restrittiva, dato che l’inflazione è rimasta al di sopra dell’obiettivo dal febbraio 2021 e non lo raggiungerà senza ulteriori misure restrittive. Su base mensile, l’indice Pce è aumentato dello 0,2% a luglio, al di sopra delle previsioni degli economisti, dopo essere sceso dello 0,1% a giugno quando aveva toccato i minimi da aprile 2020. L'Ufficio di analisi economica ha inoltre aggiornato oggi i dati sulla crescita economica del secondo trimestre, lasciando invariata la stima di crescita annualizzata del prodotto interno lordo all’1,5%.

item.title: DAZN to buy EverPass Media to expand into US commercial venues
item.description: DAZN said on Wednesday it has agreed to acquire EverPass Media that will combine DAZN's sports content with EverPass' U.S. streaming and technology capabilities.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: DAZN said on Wednesday it has agreed to acquire EverPass Media that will combine DAZN's sports content with EverPass' U.S. streaming and technology capabilities. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. Here are some details: EverPass, founded in 2023 by 32 Equity and RedBird Capital Partners, holds the exclusive commercial distribution rights for NFL Sunday Ticket in bars, restaurants and other commercial venues. RedBird Capital Partners, 32 Equity — the NFL's strategic investment arm — and TKO Group Holdings will become minority shareholders in DAZN as part of the deal. EverPass CEO Alex Kaplan will continue to lead the business, which will be rebranded as DAZN for Business. EverPass also distributes programming from the Premier League, UEFA Champions League, MLB, NBA, WNBA, NWSL and NASCAR among others, alongside partnerships with Peacock, Netflix (NFLX.O) , Paramount (PSKY.O) and Apple (AAPL.O) . Last month, EverPass and DIRECTV agreed to jointly distribute NFL Sunday Ticket via satellite and streaming to commercial venues. DAZN Group CEO Shay Segev said the deal gives the company "a proven commercial distribution platform, deep relationships across U.S. venues, and an attractive portfolio of premium rights." Existing EverPass customers will continue to receive service without interruption during the transition.

item.title: Ministro Finanze tedesco invita AD UniCredit a Berlino - fonti governative
item.description: Il ministro delle Finanze tedesco Lars Klingbeil intende incontrare Andrea Orcel, amministratore delegato di UniCredit .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il ministro delle Finanze tedesco Lars Klingbeil intende incontrare Andrea Orcel, amministratore delegato di UniCredit (CRDI.MI) . Lo hanno riferito fonti governative a Reuters, in quello che rappresenta un primo segnale della volontà di Berlino di aprire un dialogo diretto con la banca italiana sull'offerta per Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) . Klingbeil ha invitato Orcel a un incontro presso il ministero delle Finanze a Berlino il 14 settembre, hanno riportato le fonti. Nel corso del colloquio, il ministro illustrerà la posizione del governo tedesco e sottolineerà il ruolo di Commerzbank nel finanziamento dell'economia nazionale, nonché la sua rilevanza per Francoforte come centro finanziario. "Ciò va ad integrare i colloqui in corso tra le due banche, che rimangono responsabili di parlare direttamente della strada da seguire", ha aggiunto una fonte. Commerzbank non ha commentato la notizia. In precedenza, Berlino aveva insistito affinché le due banche avviassero un confronto diretto tra loro. La campagna di Commerzbank contro l’acquisizione da parte di UniCredit si è poi affievolita a luglio, dopo che UniCredit ha consolidato una partecipazione fino al 49,65%, sufficiente a determinare le delibere degli azionisti. Il governo tedesco, che detiene ancora poco più del 12% dell’istituto con sede a Francoforte a seguito del suo salvataggio durante la crisi finanziaria globale, si era a lungo opposto all'operazione, così come il management di Commerzbank. Il presidente del consiglio di sorveglianza, Jens Weidmann, ha detto domenica che Berlino dovrebbe mantenere per ora quella quota, nonostante sia stata determinata da una situazione di emergenza. L'approccio di Orcel era stato definito dal governo tedesco ostile e aggressivo. L'amministratore delegato di UniCredit, dal canto suo, aveva sollecitato l'apertura di trattative con Berlino e con i rappresentanti dei lavoratori.

item.title: Meta reaches $16.68 billion settlement over social media harms to children
item.description: Meta Platforms agreed to pay a maximum $16.68 billion and make major changes to Facebook and Instagram to resolve claims by states across the U.S. that the company designed those platforms to addict children, misled consumers about their safety and improperly collected children's personal data.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) agreed to pay a maximum $16.68 billion and make major changes to Facebook and Instagram to resolve claims by states across the U.S. that the company designed those platforms to addict children, misled consumers about their safety and improperly collected children's personal data. The settlement resolves claims brought by 29 U.S. states, and will end a federal trial that had been one of the highest-profile tests yet of allegations that social media companies harmed young users. Meta will impose daily usage limits and restrict nighttime usage by children who use Facebook and Instagram, and enhance measures to prevent children from accessing age-restricted content. The Menlo Park, California-based company denied wrongdoing in agreeing to settle. Wednesday's settlement also resolves lawsuits by California, Illinois, New Mexico and Washington, D.C., over privacy claims related to the Cambridge Analytica scandal, where the consulting firm collected personal data of millions of Facebook users. Those states will receive $459.3 million to resolve those lawsuits. Shares of Meta rose 2.3% in early trading. The claims were part of a broader wave of litigation brought by states, local governments, school districts and individuals alleging that Meta and other social media companies fueled a nationwide youth mental health crisis. The trial in the Oakland, California, federal court covered claims from California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey that Meta violated their state laws protecting consumers. It also covered claims from 29 states that Meta violated the federal Children's Online Privacy Protection Act by collecting personal data from users it knew were children without parental notification or consent, and using the data to train machine learning and generative AI models. Meta has long argued it could not have misled consumers about whether its services were addictive because "social media addiction" is not a recognized psychiatric condition. Before the trial began on August 18, Meta said California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey were seeking [USN:L6N43819A TEXT:"up to $1.4 trillion"] in penalties. The states suggested that the figure would be closer to $200 billion. A MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS Meta, Snapchat and its parent Snap (SNAP.N) , YouTube and its parent Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , and TikTok and its parent ByteDance still face thousands of lawsuits in federal and state courts over claims they knowingly designed their platforms to have features that addict children and teenagers, fueling a mental health crisis. A trial in Nashville over claims brought by Tennessee against Meta began last month. The federal cases were consolidated before U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers in Oakland, and include lawsuits brought by individuals, school districts and state governments. Earlier this year, Meta lost both phases of a landmark lawsuit brought by New Mexico. A jury in March [USN:L6N40C1AX TEXT:"ordered it to pay $375 million"] after finding it had misled consumers about the safety of its platforms. On August 6, a judge found Meta had created a public nuisance and ordered it [USN:L6N4431IA TEXT:"to pay an additional $567 million"] and implement youth-safety measures. Also in March, the first trial over an individual’s claims against Meta and Google ended with [USN:L6N40D166 TEXT:"a verdict"] in the plaintiff's favor. A Los Angeles jury found the companies liable for plaintiff Kaley G.M.'s depression and anxiety and ordered them to pay a combined $6 million in damages. The companies have said they will appeal those verdicts.

item.title: Alluvione Nepal, Farnesina verifica coinvolgimento italiani, circa 90 presenti in area
item.description: Il ministero degli Esteri sta verificando l'eventuale coinvolgimento di cittadini italiani dopo la vasta frana e le inondazioni improvvise che hanno colpito un'area al confine tra Nepal e Tibet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il ministero degli Esteri sta verificando l'eventuale coinvolgimento di cittadini italiani dopo la vasta frana e le inondazioni improvvise che hanno colpito un'area al confine tra Nepal e Tibet. In una nota, la Farnesina ha detto che l'Unità di Crisi è al lavoro fin dalle prime notizie dell'evento ed è in contatto con il Consolato generale d'Italia a Calcutta, il Consolato onorario a Kathmandu e l'Ambasciata d'Italia a Pechino per monitorare la situazione e fornire assistenza se necessario. Secondo le registrazioni sul portale "Dove siamo nel mondo", sono circa 90 i cittadini italiani presenti tra Nepal e Tibet, mentre due turisti italiani e la loro guida risultano bloccati a monte di uno smottamento che ha interrotto una strada. Nel frattempo, le autorità nepalesi hanno riferito che almeno 384 viaggiatori, tra cui 291 cittadini stranieri, risultano dispersi dopo le alluvioni lampo che hanno colpito l'area di confine con il Tibet. Tra gli stranieri scomparsi figurano 105 cittadini indiani. Secondo il Nepal Tourism Board, almeno nove persone sono morte nelle inondazioni.

item.title: Landmark Bolivia same-sex marriage could pave way for more couples, activists say
item.description: The marriage of a same-sex couple in Bolivia this month could prompt other couples to seek the same recognition, activists say, potentially opening a new chapter in a years-long push for LGBT rights in the socially conservative Andean nation.
item.dc:creator: Sergio Limachi, Andrea Rodriguez
item.content:encoded: The marriage of a same-sex couple in Bolivia this month could prompt other couples to seek the same recognition, activists say, potentially opening a new chapter in a years-long push for LGBT rights in the socially conservative Andean nation. Fabiana Justiniano and Scarlett Rocha applied to marry in October 2022. After nearly four years of legal proceedings and two constitutional appeals, they won a ruling in March 2026 clearing the way for their wedding — Bolivia's first legally recognized same-sex marriage. "We had many doubts, a lot of uncertainty ... because the process was so long and during the process there were so many barriers, so many limitations, even on the day of the wedding," Rocha said. For Justiniano, the union brought a different kind of relief. "For me, marriage means peace," she said, recalling their first night home as a married couple, when she realized everything they had built now belonged "only and exclusively to us." Nonetheless, the Bolivian court's ruling applies only to their specific case. Same-sex marriage is not yet available nationwide through Bolivia's administrative rules, and future access will hinge on further Constitutional Court rulings. Mateo Rodrigo, a lawyer with Equal Bolivia who represented the couple, said the ruling has already triggered interest from others. "Since Fabiana and Scarlett's wedding we have already received quite a few requests, around five to 10 couples have approached us," he said, though many remain hesitant given the nearly four-year fight the couple endured. Same-sex civil unions similarly moved into legal territory after a landmark case in 2020, when David Aruquipa and Guido Montaño won a two-year legal battle. It took until 2023 for further court rulings to make the registration of same-sex civil unions broadly available. Since then, Bolivia has recognized 148 same sex-civil unions, said Paola Tapia, who oversees the vulnerable populations unit at Bolivia's Ombudsman's Office. She added that unions still carry fewer practical protections than marriage. "With marriage, we're opening many more doors. With civil unions, we opened a few," said Montaño. "The situation now is much better for people who can choose between marriage and a civil union." Cuba in 2022 became the [USN:L1N30X2L6 TEXT:"latest country"] in Latin America to legalize gay marriage and adoption, but little has changed in the region since. Same-sex marriage remains illegal or unrecognized across much of Central America, Paraguay, Peru, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname and parts of the Caribbean.

item.title: Inflación en EEUU sigue elevada en julio; PIB del segundo trimestre se mantiene al 1,5%
item.description: La inflación anual de Estados Unidos se mantuvo inesperadamente estable en julio, muy por encima del objetivo del 2% de la Reserva Federal por 65º mes consecutivo, y es probable que la pausa en el descenso desde el reciente máximo provocado por la guerra con Irán agrave el debate sobre si hay que subir las tasas de interés.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La inflación anual de Estados Unidos se mantuvo inesperadamente estable en julio, muy por encima del objetivo del 2% de la Reserva Federal por 65º mes consecutivo, y es probable que la pausa en el descenso desde el reciente máximo provocado por la guerra con Irán agrave el debate sobre si hay que subir las tasas de interés. El índice de precios de los gastos de consumo personal (PCE) aumentó un 3,7% en los doce meses hasta julio, sin cambios respecto a junio, según informó el miércoles la Oficina de Análisis Económico del Departamento de Comercio. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters esperaban un 3,6%. El PCE se disparó en mayo a un máximo de tres años del 4,1%, después de que el presidente Donald Trump lanzó a fines de febrero, junto con Israel, ataques aéreos contra Irán, lo que provocó una espiral alcista de los precios de la energía, ya que el conflicto afectó a cerca de una quinta parte del suministro mundial de crudo. Seis meses después, el conflicto no parece estar más cerca de una resolución definitiva, aunque los enfrentamientos han disminuido y los precios del petróleo —así como la ola de inflación más generalizada que provocaron— han retrocedido desde los máximos alcanzados a mediados de primavera. El retroceso de la inflación en los dos últimos meses ha contribuido a reforzar los argumentos de la mayoría de los miembros del Comité Federal de Mercado Abierto que votaron a favor de mantener las tasas sin cambios en julio, en el rango del 3,5%-3,75%, donde se han mantenido desde diciembre. Sin embargo, es poco probable que el lento ritmo de mejora apacigüe a una minoría cada vez mayor de autoridades monetarias que defienden que se necesita una política más restrictiva, dado que la inflación está por encima del objetivo desde febrero de 2021 y no lo alcanzará sin nuevas medidas de contención. La inflación medida por el índice PCE —que la Fed utiliza para fijar su objetivo— alcanzó un máximo del 7,2% en junio de 2022 y las alzas de tasas más pronunciadas de la Fed desde los años 80 contribuyeron a situarla de nuevo en la senda hacia el 2%. Esa trayectoria cambió el año pasado después de que Trump desatara una oleada de aranceles a las importaciones a su regreso a la Casa Blanca, lo que provocó un aumento de los precios de una amplia gama de productos, presiones que se vieron agravadas con la guerra en Irán. Es probable que surjan nuevas presiones provocadas por los aranceles, después de que las negociaciones comerciales entre Estados Unidos y su segundo socio comercial, Canadá, fracasaran el viernes, abriendo la puerta a nuevos gravámenes sobre 20.000 millones de dólares en importaciones de productos canadienses. Desde entonces, tanto Washington como Ottawa han anunciado medidas de represalia adicionales que entrarán en vigor en los próximos meses, a menos que se alcance un acuerdo para evitarlas. En términos intermensuales, el PCE subió un 0,2% en julio —también por encima de las previsiones de los economistas— tras caer un 0,1% en junio, lo que había sido el dato más débil desde abril de 2020. Por otra parte, la Oficina de Análisis Económico (BEA) actualizó los datos sobre el crecimiento económico del segundo trimestre, manteniendo sin cambios en el 1,5% su estimación del crecimiento anualizado del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB).

item.title: Intesa Sanpaolo complains to market watchdog over MPS defensive moves in M&A battle
item.description: Intesa Sanpaolo on Wednesday filed a complaint to Italy's market watchdog Consob over transactions that smaller rival Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) has announced following Intesa's offer for it, a source close to the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) on Wednesday filed a complaint to Italy's market watchdog Consob over transactions that smaller rival Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) (MPS) has announced following Intesa's offer for it, a source close to the matter said. Last week MPS announced two [USN:L1N44H0NA TEXT:"simultaneous, all-share bids"], totaling about €34 billion ($39.7 billion), on rival Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) and wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) , as it seeks to fend off a 30.6 billion cash-and-share [USN:L4N42G0DE TEXT:"hostile takeover"] approach launched by Intesa in June. The compliant aims to clarify whether MPS has complied with regulations the source said, citing in particular the so-called "passivity rule," which restricts the scope of a target company to take defensive measures against a takeover bid.

item.title: Inflação nos EUA continua elevada em julho; PIB do 2º trimestre permanece inalterado em 1,5%
item.description: A inflação anual dos Estados Unidos permaneceu bem acima da meta de 2% do Federal Reserve em julho pelo 65º mês consecutivo, e a pausa na queda em relação ao pico recente induzido pela guerra com o Irã provavelmente contribuirá para o tenso debate do banco central sobre se a taxa de juros deve ser elevada ou mantida.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A inflação anual dos Estados Unidos permaneceu bem acima da meta de 2% do Federal Reserve em julho pelo 65º mês consecutivo, e a pausa na queda em relação ao pico recente induzido pela guerra com o Irã provavelmente contribuirá para o tenso debate do banco central sobre se a taxa de juros deve ser elevada ou mantida. O índice de preços PCE subiu 3,7% nos 12 meses até julho, repetindo a taxa de junho, informou nesta quarta-feira o Bureau de Análise Econômica do Departamento de Comércio. Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam alta de 3,6% para o PCE, que o Fed utiliza para definir sua meta. O PCE disparou para a máxima em três anos de 4,1% em maio depois que o presidente Donald Trump lançou no final de fevereiro ataques aéreos em conjunto com Israel contra o Irã, fazendo com que os preços da energia disparassem, já que o conflito interrompeu cerca de um quinto do abastecimento global de petróleo. Seis meses depois, o conflito não parece estar mais próximo de uma resolução definitiva, embora os confrontos tenham diminuído e os preços do petróleo e a inflação que eles provocaram tenham recuado em relação às máximas registradas em meados da primavera. A retração da inflação nos últimos dois meses ajudou a reforçar os argumentos da maioria dos membros do Comitê Federal de Mercado Aberto (Fomc) que votaram pela manutenção dos juros em julho na faixa de 3,50% a 3,75%, onde se encontram desde dezembro. Mas é improvável que o ritmo lento da melhora acalme uma minoria crescente de autoridades que defendem que é necessária uma política monetária mais apertada, já que a inflação está acima da meta desde fevereiro de 2021 e não chegará lá sem mais restrições. A inflação medida pelo PCE atingiu o pico de 7,2% em junho de 2022, e os aumentos mais acentuados dos juros pelo Fed desde a década de 1980 ajudaram a colocá-la em um caminho de retorno aos 2%. Essa trajetória mudou no ano passado, depois que Trump desencadeou uma onda de tarifas de importação ao retornar à Casa Branca, elevando os preços de uma ampla gama de produtos, com a guerra no Irã agravando essas pressões. Na comparação mensal, o PCE subiu 0,2% em julho — também acima das previsões dos economistas —, após cair 0,1% em junho, que havia sido o resultado mais fraco desde abril de 2020. Também nesta quarta-feira, o Bureau atualizou os dados sobre o crescimento econômico do segundo trimestre, mantendo sua estimativa de crescimento anualizado do Produto Interno Bruto em 1,5%. (Reportagem de Dan Burns)

item.title: Germany's Merz seeks to project confidence with growth target
item.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Wednesday vowed to revive the German economy and deliver growth of at least 1% next year thanks to business-friendly reforms and a planned increase in government spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Wednesday vowed to revive the German economy and deliver growth of at least 1% next year thanks to business-friendly reforms and a planned increase in government spending. Seeking to project unity, Merz and Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil, whose centre-left SPD is the junior partner in the coalition, also dismissed suggestions that government infighting was hampering efforts to reverse a slide in opinion polls. "I feel encouraged in my assessment that we have the opportunity to achieve a one before the comma (in GDP growth) for the next year," said Merz, leader of the conservative CDU. He was speaking at a news conference after an off-site cabinet meeting at the Neuhardenberg estate, about 70 km (44 miles) east of Berlin, following the summer break. The economy ministry in April cut its 2026 growth forecast to 0.5% from 1%, citing higher energy costs linked to the war in Iran. [USN:L8N43U15L TEXT:"Pressure "]on Merz's coalition has been mounting after a cabinet reshuffle angered members of his own party and raised questions about the government's effectiveness as it seeks to fend off a far-right challenge in state elections next month. Merz and Klingbeil said recent economic data and business surveys pointed to an improving outlook. After years of weak growth, Europe's largest economy expanded more strongly in the second quarter than initially estimated, while [USN:L8N44M0D2 TEXT:"business morale"] rose to its highest level in a year in August. Merz also said he had asked federal ministers to develop proposals to address trade imbalances between the European Union and China.

item.title: Vanguard strikes deal for fintech platform Altruist
item.description: Vanguard Group said on Wednesday it would acquire fintech platform Altruist, giving the asset manager greater access to independent financial advisers and expanding its wealth-management capabilities.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vanguard Group said on Wednesday it would acquire fintech platform Altruist, giving the asset manager greater access to independent financial advisers and expanding its wealth-management capabilities. Here are some more details: While the terms of the deal were not disclosed, the Wall Street Journal said the transaction was worth roughly $4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter. Founded in 2018, Altruist is a wealth-management technology platform used by independent financial advisers. It is a competitor to Charles Schwab and Fidelity's custody businesses. "As more investors in Vanguard funds choose to work with financial advisors, we see a significant opportunity to build on the strengths of two highly complementary organizations to help advisors serve clients more effectively," said Salim Ramji, CEO of Vanguard. The deal aligns with Ramji's strategy of expanding Vanguard's advice and wealth-management business as asset managers push further into serving affluent clients. Vanguard, which managed about $12 trillion in assets as of March 31, also acquired wealth-management technology provider Just Invest in 2021. Following the deal's close, Altruist will continue to run as a separate business under Vanguard's ownership. The transaction is expected to close later this year.

item.title: Uefa deve retirar ameaça de boicote à Fifa, dizem fontes
item.description: A Uefa deve retirar sua ameaça de boicotar os torneios da Fifa após receber garantias de que os planos de vender participações na Copa do Mundo e em outras competições importantes não serão retomados, informaram à Reuters fontes a par das discussões nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Uefa deve retirar sua ameaça de boicotar os torneios da Fifa após receber garantias de que os planos de vender participações na Copa do Mundo e em outras competições importantes não serão retomados, informaram à Reuters fontes a par das discussões nesta quarta-feira. A medida ocorreu após a decisão da Fifa, em julho, de retirar uma proposta que gerou oposição das 55 associações-membro da Uefa, que haviam concordado em boicotar as competições da Fifa após a divulgação dos detalhes do plano no mês passado. Espera-se que os dirigentes da Uefa informem ao comitê executivo da entidade e aos presidentes da maioria de suas associações-membro, em uma reunião em Mônaco na quinta-feira, que as condições para o fim do boicote foram atendidas, disseram as fontes. A Uefa havia solicitado tanto a retirada da proposta quanto garantias de que planos semelhantes não seriam novamente levados adiante. “Não se trata de uma derrota da Uefa, mas sim da realidade de evitar prejudicar jovens atletas em uma oportunidade única na vida. As ações e a insistência em mudanças continuarão”, disse à Reuters uma fonte a par das discussões. Embora se espere que a ameaça imediata de um boicote seja suspensa, a Uefa provavelmente continuará sua campanha contra o presidente da Fifa, Gianni Infantino, em relação à proposta de venda, segundo as fontes. Espera-se que a questão seja discutida na reunião de Mônaco. As seleções estão se preparando para a Copa do Mundo Feminina Sub-20 da Fifa na Polônia, que tem início previsto para 5 de setembro. (Reportagem de Karan Prashant Saxena, em Bengaluru, e Julien Pretot)
